subject: MSA kickoff: evidence map & initial redline primer
messages:
From: Sylvia Perez <sylvia.perez@novalogic.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-05-11 09:13 -0700
Subject: MSA kickoff: evidence map & initial asks

Hi David —

Thanks for taking the time earlier. Were ready to start the MSA + order form lift and wanted to get the intake in motion so legal and procurement can schedule their review. Two asks to start:

1) Can you confirm which template youll use (Redwood standard MSA) and attach the editable PDF?
2) Weve attached our RFI evidence list (see attachment). Please indicate owners and estimated delivery dates for: SOC 2 report, retention policy, data flow diagram, and IP subcontractor list.

High level timeline from our side: procurement review next Tue (5/13), legal redline round on 5/15, final internal sign-off week of 5/19. If you have mandatory hosting/residency exhibits, call them out now.

Ive copied Jordan and Marissa for billing/contact details. Anders (legal) will be on the thread after initial scope is confirmed.

Thanks,

--
Sylvia Perez
Head of Procurement
Novalogic
attachments: Novalogic_RFI_evidence_list.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sylvia Perez <sylvia.perez@novalogic.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-05-11 11:02 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA kickoff: evidence map & initial asks

Sylvia — great to kick this off. Quick responses below and next steps.

- Template: we use the Redwood Standard MSA (editable attached). Ive included a cleaned PDF and the Word source for redlines.
- Evidence owners (first pass):
  • SOC 2 report: Kimberly Park (legal & compliance) — expected 5/14 (we can provide the latest report and mapping notes).
  • Data retention policy + DFD: Marissa Cole (ops) — working on updated DFD, delivery 5/13.
  • IP/subcontractor list: David Kim — Ill pull and send by 5/12 EOD.

Proposed intake steps:
1) Ill upload the MSA Word to the Drive link you shared and flag comment mode for redlines.
2) Kimberly will do a prioritized clause pass (liability/residency/data use) and return a delta list by 5/14.
3) Jordan will own billing/seat counts on the order form and share draft terms for pricing cadence.

If procurement needs a mutual action plan (MAP) we can sketch one quickly and attach to the DocuSign envelope.

Attached: Redwood_Standard_MSA_v1.docx, Redwood_Standard_MSA_v1.pdf

Thanks —
David
Director, GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Standard_MSA_v1.docx (document), Redwood_Standard_MSA_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sylvia Perez <sylvia.perez@novalogic.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-05-12 09:18 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA kickoff: evidence map & initial asks

Thanks — Ill take the clause-priority pass. My plan / checklist below:

Quick checklist for Novalogic intake (what Ill produce by 5/14):
- Executive summary of material changes we expect from template redline (1 page)
- Clause heatmap: priority (High: liability/indemnity/limitation of liability; High: data residency & subprocessing; Med: termination & transition; Low: marketing/PR)
- Evidence delivery map: confirm which items are publicly FOSS vs signed NDA items (SOC 2, diagram, retention) and expected handoff path (drive link vs secured transfer)
- Counterparty asks that usually trigger negotiations: data residency carveouts, export controls, and indemnity caps tied to committed spend

Attachments Ill include in initial package: redline delta checklist (Google Doc link), copy of latest SOC 2 (redacted placeholder), and marking for the retention exhibit. Note: for SOC 2 we normally share the report under NDA; if Novalogic prefers earlier access to control mapping, we can provide a self-attestation first.

Request for Novalogic: please confirm which GCP region(s) the platform will be used from (us-west/us-east/eu-central) and whether there are any special residency controls required for backups. That will influence the residency exhibit language.

KK
Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Compliance & Privacy
Redwood Inference
attachments: SOC2_redacted_placeholder.pdf (pdf), Redline_delta_checklist.gdoc (link)

From: Anders H. <anders.helgason@novalogic.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sylvia Perez <sylvia.perez@novalogic.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-05-12 16:02 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA kickoff: evidence map & initial asks

Kim / David —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Two clarifications from our legal side:
1) We need either a SOC 2 Type II for the most recent 12-month period or the SOC 2 plus a controls mapping that shows where each control is in scope. A placeholder is fine for procurement, but legal will request the Type II with the redline.
2) Residency: Novalogic will require EU data at-rest residency for a small subset of records (PII related to EU customers). Can Redwood propose exhibit language for cross-border access and a carveout for EU at-rest retention?

If you can share the redline checklist by tomorrow morning, well try to get procurement comments in time for the 5/15 legal redline window.

Thanks —
Anders Helgason
Chief Legal Officer (interim)
Novalogic
